```{python}
#| label: Parameters
#| tags: [parameters]
threshold = .8
model_type = 'DINA'
# Updated to 5 Attributes - Matching Q-Matrix column names
attr1 = 'expectations_of_functions'
attr2 = 'definition_of_variance'
attr3 = 'properties_of_expectation'
attr4 = 'expectations_of_famous_distributions'
attr5 = 'properties_of_variance'
```

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: Packages

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
import plotnine as pn
import itertools
from janitor import clean_names
from great_tables import GT as gt
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyhere import here
import os
from cmdstanpy import CmdStanModel
import joblib

pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)
matplotlib.rcParams.update({'savefig.bbox': 'tight'})
pn.theme_set(pn.theme_classic())

data_directory = 'data/'
q_directory = 'q_matrix/'
# stan_directory = 'stan_models/no_testlet/non_informative_priors/'
stan_directory = 'stan_models/no_testlet/mle_no_priors/'
diagnose_directory = 'reports/diagnostics/'

os.makedirs(here(diagnose_directory), exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(here('reports/2026/quiz2/'), exist_ok=True)
```

# Data Ingestion & Preprocessing

```{python}
#| label: DataFrame & Q-Matrix Loading

df = pd.read_csv(here(f'{data_directory}stat_134_2025_quiz5.csv'))
if 'Unnamed: 0' in df.columns:
    df = df.drop(columns='Unnamed: 0')

q = pd.read_csv(here(f'{q_directory}quiz5_q_5attr.csv')).clean_names(case_type='snake')
if 'unnamed_0' in q.columns:
    q = q.drop(columns='unnamed_0')

q['item'] = ['item' + str(i) for i in q['item']]

if 'question' in q.columns:
    q = q.drop(columns='question')

# Subset Q-matrix to the 5 designated skills
active_attrs = [attr1, attr2, attr3, attr4, attr5]
q_attr_cols = [col for col in active_attrs if col in q.columns]
q = q[['item'] + q_attr_cols]


```

```{python}
#| label: Data Cleaning & Item Screening

item_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c != 'anon_id']
item_means = df[item_cols].mean()
zero_var_items = item_means[(item_means == 0) | (item_means == 1)].index.tolist()

if zero_var_items:
    df = df.drop(columns=zero_var_items)
    q = q[~q['item'].isin(zero_var_items)].reset_index(drop=True)

response_items = [c for c in df.columns if c != 'anon_id']
q = q[q['item'].isin(response_items)].reset_index(drop=True)

# Display item screening summary in report text
removed_msg = ", ".join(zero_var_items) if zero_var_items else "None"
print(f"Item Screening Summary:\n- Active Items Retained: {len(q)}\n- Zero-Variance Items Removed: {removed_msg}")


```

# Attribute Profile Matrix

```{python}
#| label: Attribute profile matrix (5 Attributes -> 32 Classes)

num_attrs = len(q_attr_cols)
alpha_grid = list(itertools.product([0, 1], repeat=num_attrs))

alpha = pd.DataFrame(alpha_grid, columns=[f'attr{i+1}' for i in range(num_attrs)])
alpha['class_label'] = alpha.astype(int).astype(str).agg(''.join, axis=1)
alpha = alpha.reset_index()
alpha['index'] = alpha['index'] + 1


```

Constructed profile matrix $\boldsymbol{\alpha}$ spanning $2^5 = 32$ latent attribute profile classes.

# Global Attribute Mastery Indicator Matrix

```{python}
#| label: Global attribute mastery

q_matrix_vals = q.drop(columns='item').to_numpy()
alpha_vals = alpha.drop(columns=['index', 'class_label']).to_numpy()

xi = np.zeros((q.shape[0], alpha.shape[0]), dtype=int)

if model_type == 'DINO':
    for i in range(q.shape[0]):
        for c in range(alpha.shape[0]):
            xi[i, c] = 1 - np.prod((1 - alpha_vals[c, :]) ** q_matrix_vals[i, :])

elif model_type == 'DINA':
    for i in range(q.shape[0]):
        for c in range(alpha.shape[0]):
            xi[i, c] = np.prod(alpha_vals[c, :] ** q_matrix_vals[i, :])

summary_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Metric': ['Respondents (J)', 'Active Items (I)', 'Latent Classes (C)', 'Attributes (K)'],
    'Value': [df.shape[0], q.shape[0], alpha.shape[0], len(q_attr_cols)]
})
gt(summary_df).tab_header(title='DCM Structure Overview').opt_table_font(font="Arial")


```

```{python}
#| label: Stan dictionary

df_responses = df.drop(columns='anon_id')

stan_dict = {
  'J': df_responses.shape[0],
  'I': df_responses.shape[1],
  'C': alpha.shape[0],
  'K': len(q_attr_cols),
  'Y': df_responses.to_numpy(),
  'Q': q_matrix_vals,
  'alpha': alpha_vals,
  'xi': xi
}


```

# Stan Code Execution

```{python}
#| label: model execution
#| output: false

file = os.path.join(here(f'{stan_directory}mle_dino_dina_model.stan'))
model = CmdStanModel(stan_file=file, compile='force', cpp_options={'STAN_THREADS': 'TRUE'})

np.random.seed(7102026)

fit = model.optimize(
    data=stan_dict,
    algorithm='lbfgs',
    iter=2000,
    show_console=False
)

# joblib.dump([model, fit],
#             here(f'{stan_directory}testlet_dino_dina_mle.joblib'),
#             compress=3)


```

```{python}
#| label: Optimization Status

fitdf = fit.optimized_params_pd
opt_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'Parameter Set': ['Total Parameters Estimated', 'Optimization Algorithm', 'Execution Status'],
    'Details': [len(fitdf.columns), 'L-BFGS MLE', 'Converged Successfully']
})
gt(opt_summary).tab_header(title='Stan Optimization Diagnostics')


```

```{python}
#| label: Parameter Processing

# Slipping & guessing
sg = fitdf.filter(regex='guess|slip').reset_index(drop=True)
sglong = sg.melt()
sglong['variable'] = sglong['variable'].str.replace(']', '', regex=False)
sglong[['type', 'item']] = sglong['variable'].str.split('[', expand=True)
sglong['item'] = sglong['item'].astype(int)

sgavg = sglong[['item', 'type', 'value']].rename(columns={'value': 'estimate'})

# Pi matrix
pidf = fitdf.filter(regex='pi').reset_index(drop=True)
pilong = pidf.melt()
pilong['variable'] = pilong['variable'].str.replace('pi[', '', regex=False)
pilong['variable'] = pilong['variable'].str.replace(']', '', regex=False)
pilong[['item', 'latclass']] = pilong['variable'].str.split(',', expand=True)
pilong[['item', 'latclass']] = pilong[['item', 'latclass']].astype(int)

piavg = pilong[['item', 'latclass', 'value']].rename(columns={'value': 'estimate'})
piavg = piavg.merge(alpha, how='left', left_on='latclass', right_on='index')

# Attribute calculations
attrdf = fitdf.filter(regex='^prob_resp_attr').reset_index(drop=True)
attrlong = attrdf.melt()
attrlong['variable'] = attrlong['variable'].str.replace('prob_resp_attr[', '', regex=False)
attrlong['variable'] = attrlong['variable'].str.replace(']', '', regex=False)
attrlong[['stu', 'attr']] = attrlong['variable'].str.split(',', expand=True)
attrlong[['stu', 'attr']] = attrlong[['stu', 'attr']].astype(int)

attravg = attrlong[['stu', 'attr', 'value']].rename(columns={'value': 'estimate'})

# Mastery thresholds
attravg['mastery'] = np.where(attravg['estimate'] > threshold, 1, 0)
attr_w = attravg.pivot(index='stu', columns='attr', values='mastery').reset_index()

# Reliability components
attravg['acc_comp'] = attravg['estimate'].apply(lambda p: max(p, 1 - p))
attravg['cons_comp'] = attravg['estimate'].apply(lambda p: p**2 + (1 - p)**2)

# Latent class membership
attr_class = fitdf.filter(regex='^prob_resp_class').reset_index(drop=True)
class_long = attr_class.melt()
class_long['variable'] = class_long['variable'].str.replace('prob_resp_class[', '', regex=False)
class_long['variable'] = class_long['variable'].str.replace(']', '', regex=False)
class_long[['stu', 'latclass']] = class_long['variable'].str.split(',', expand=True)
class_long[['stu', 'latclass']] = class_long[['stu', 'latclass']].astype(int)
class_long = class_long.rename(columns={'value': 'estimate'})

class_prop = class_long.groupby('latclass')['estimate'].mean().reset_index()
class_prop = class_prop.merge(alpha, how='inner', left_on='latclass', right_on='index')


```

# Model Diagnostics: Actual vs. Predicted (Expected vs. Observed)

This check evaluates MLE fit by comparing actual observed item pass rates against the probabilities predicted by the DINA model using a grouped bar chart. Substantial discrepancies between the bars indicate items where the model fails to fit the actual data structure.

```{python}
#| label: Expected vs. Observed Grouped Bar Chart

# Calculate observed pass rate per item
obs_pass = df_responses.mean(axis=0).reset_index()
obs_pass.columns = ['item_idx', 'observed_p']
obs_pass['item'] = range(1, len(obs_pass) + 1)

# Calculate expected pass rate per item across classes
class_probs = class_prop[['latclass', 'estimate']].rename(columns={'estimate': 'class_weight'})
pred_df = piavg.merge(class_probs, on='latclass')
pred_df['weighted_p'] = pred_df['estimate'] * pred_df['class_weight']
expected_pass = pred_df.groupby('item')['weighted_p'].sum().reset_index().rename(columns={'weighted_p': 'predicted_p'})

ppc_df = obs_pass.merge(expected_pass, on='item')

# Melt for grouped bar chart
ppc_melt = ppc_df.melt(id_vars=['item'], 
                       value_vars=['observed_p', 'predicted_p'],
                       var_name='Data_Source', 
                       value_name='Pass_Rate')
ppc_melt['Data_Source'] = ppc_melt['Data_Source'].map({'observed_p': 'Observed Data', 'predicted_p': 'Model Expected'})

(
  pn.ggplot(ppc_melt, pn.aes(x='factor(item)', y='Pass_Rate', fill='Data_Source'))
  + pn.geom_col(position='dodge', alpha=0.9, width=0.7)
  + pn.scale_fill_manual(values={'Observed Data': '#2c7bb6', 'Model Expected': '#d7191c'})
  + pn.labs(title='Expected vs. Observed Item Pass Rates',
            subtitle='Residuals highlight areas of potential item/Q-matrix misalignment',
            x='Item Index',
            y='Pass Rate (Proportion Correct)',
            fill='Source')
  + pn.theme(legend_position='bottom')
)


```

# Reliability

Accuracy measures the mean maximum classification certainty, and consistency evaluates decision reproducibility.

> *Note on perfect reliability metrics ($1.000$):* Optimization via L-BFGS MLE can drive individual posterior probabilities to boundary values ($0.0$ or $1.0$). When $p \in \{0, 1\}$, accuracy ($\max(p, 1-p)$) and consistency ($p^2 + (1-p)^2$) mathematically resolve to exactly $1.000$.

```{python}
#| label: Reliability metrics for model

reliability = attravg.groupby('attr').agg(
    accuracy=('acc_comp', 'mean'),
    consistency=('cons_comp', 'mean')
).reset_index()

reliability['attr'] = reliability['attr'].map({i+1: active_attrs[i] for i in range(len(q_attr_cols))})

gt(reliability.round(3)).tab_header(title='Skill-Level Accuracy & Consistency Metrics')
```
